mapper.update: UPDATE product_category SET parent_id=#{parentId},name=#{name},sort_no=#{sortNo},status=#{status},updated_at=#{now} WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND id=#{categoryId}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM product_category WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND id=#{categoryId}
SELECT FROM product_category WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND parent_id=#{parentId} ORDER BY sort_no ASC,id ASC
SELECT FROM product_category WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId} ORDER BY parent_id IS NULL DESC,sort_no ASC,id ASC
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_category WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND parent_id=#{parentId})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND category_id=#{categoryId} AND status <> 'DISCONTINUED')
